# Installation instructions

Copy this block only when a new regular installation.md was selected. For an external document follow its conventions and preserve the symlink. Replace placeholders with confirmed procedural choices, not execution-history summaries.

## installation.md

```markdown
# {{HOSTNAME}} installation instructions

- Follow this machine-specific recipe in execution order; ask before system-change batches and consequential new choices.
- Use actionable bullets extensively. Keep routine dates, observed-version snapshots, completion notes and user-confirmation narratives in Agents references/history, not this recipe.
- Include prerequisites, exact commands/settings where useful, meaningful exceptions and verification steps to perform. Retain a version/date only when it materially affects reproduction or compatibility.

## Sources and prerequisites

- Read the [Agents workspace recipe](https://github.com/pallgeuer/la-dev-codex-plugins/blob/main/docs/computer_setup_recipe.md) and relevant current official procedures before execution.
- {{REQUIRED_ACCESS_BACKUPS_INPUTS_AND_RELEVANT_OFFICIAL_GUIDES}}

## Installation procedure

- Establish usable Codex administration, create its workspace, then restore/connect the selected canonical installation document before optional tooling/customization, respecting prerequisites.
- If that document is unavailable, use a verified temporary workspace recipe; preserve any existing dangling installation link and choose a separate temporary filename. Reconcile preserved entries with the restored canonical source, verify the handoff, and retain temporary material until separately approved cleanup. Do not implicitly commit temporary content or change Git file types.
- {{ACTIONABLE_STEPS_WITH_MACHINE_CHOICES_COMMANDS_SETTINGS_AND_CHECKS}}

## Remaining setup

- **Planned:** {{UNFINISHED_STEPS_OR_LINK_TO_AUTHORITATIVE_QUEUE}}
- Keep completed/executed setup before this planned/deferred queue and any OLD material, in a useful installation/dependency order.
- After a step succeeds, remove its Planned marker and move its reusable procedure into the completed portion; do not replace it with a dated completion entry. Keep unfinished substeps explicitly planned, splitting substantial pending work when useful. Never imply planned work ran.
- Preserve heading anchors or repair incoming links when moving sections. Preserve unrelated decisions, commands and historical OLD material; do not regenerate an existing recipe.

## Upkeep

- Keep current when relevant; ask the user if unsure whether or how to update this recipe.
- Link generic procedures instead of duplicating them, while retaining essential machine-specific context and genuine refusals/deviations.
- Keep shared-note links within the collection or use actual cross-device web resources, never host-only paths or external symlink contents.
```
